outcome: complication-free catheter survival at 90 and 365 days
overall catheter survival at 90 and 365 days
cohort: 260 patients who underwent their first peritoneal dialysis catheter (PDC) placement between January 2005 and June 2016
finding: Fluoroscopic and ultrasound-guided placement of peritoneal dialysis catheters demonstrated similar safety and effectiveness compared to laparoscopic placement.
